VAR TYPE ; (next register is an uninitialized anonymous variable).
VAR_C rvalue-src ; (next register is a local variable representation of the specified Ref/Var).
VAR_CN rvalue-ref, STRING ; (next register is a named capture (a de-ref) of a Ref/Var).
VAR_D TYPE ; next register is an anonymous "dynamic reference" variable.
VAR_DN TYPE, STRING ; next register is a named "dynamic reference" variable.
VAR_I TYPE, rvalue-src ; (next register is an initialized anonymous variable).
VAR_IN TYPE, STRING, rvalue-src ; (next register is an initialized named variable).
VAR_M TYPE, entries:(rvalue, rvalue) ; next register is an initialized anonymous Map variable.
VAR_MN TYPE, STRING, entries:(rvalue, rvalue) ; next register is an initialized named Map variable.
VAR_N TYPE, STRING ; (next register is an uninitialized named variable).
VAR_S TYPE, values:(rvalue-src) ; next register is an initialized anonymous Array variable.
VAR_SN TYPE, STRING, values:(rvalue-src) ; next register is an initialized named Array variable.
VAR_T values:(TYPE, rvalue-src) ; next register is an initialized anonymous Tuple variable.
VAR_TN STRING, values:(TYPE, rvalue-src) ; next register is an initialized named Tuple variable.
Base class for all XVM machine code instructions, each of which is called an "op".
